stem: On average, how many respiratory tract infections do children under six years of age experience annually?
explanation: Children in this age group typically experience this many infections per year, a frequency that can increase further if they attend daycare.
rationale: Consider the typical frequency that often surprises parents who feel their children are constantly unwell.
